level_id_bank.verdict: Range-bound into results inside a drawn symmetrical triangle (~1,847-1,980 on 27-Oct, apex ~1,910 mid-Nov), sitting on the 1D MA stack. Strong support is the purple box 1,738-1,800 on the long EMA and the Jul-Aug lows; supply 2,020-2,062. Act on the first post-results close, not the gap.
level_id_bank.method: No level-ID ladder on the frame. Box and triangle pixel-measured against the 1,896.7 price tag and the 1,801.1 EMA tag (0.831 INR/px, cross-checked against the 25-INR axis step). Swing points from GENERATORS/_cache/historical_ohlc.csv.
